title: stainless steel sauce pan
text: stainless steel sauce pan. I purchased this pan because the lid was domed well and I wanted to use to coddle eggs.  Works perfectly and as I had hoped.  The lid offers a strain option too.  The lid is clear glass.  I sometimes put the lid in the dishwasher - but always hand wash the pan.  Easy to do.  It has a pour edge on the pan.  Honestly if you don't have a 'sauce' pan, this one THE sauce pan.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
